tags.note: Closes to pedestrians in the evening (exact time depends by season) but you can call on the interphone and they'll send a police car for to take you to the other side. Bikes allowed at night but must call on the interphone. Hours and instructions here: ht

tags.name: Golden Gate Bridge West Sidewalk
tags.note: Bicyclists use west sidewalk during weekday afternoons and on weekend days. At other times, bicyclists share east sidewalk with pedestrians. Detailed hours here: https://www.goldengate.org/bridge/visiting-the-bridge/bikes-pedestrians/
